messages:
cam: Quick thread  proposal: introduce a "pin probation" flow for new catalog entries instead of an immediate permanent pin. Idea is to let customers pin but with automatic telemetry gates and a short probation TTL.

yasmin: Love the idea. Can you sketch the gates? What signals would auto-unpin?

cam: Rough gates: 1) seed-stability (N=30) variance <3%, 2) latency P95 within 20% of baseline, 3) no customer-facing regression on a small prompt set. If any gate fails during probation, auto-unpin and notify.

jorge: Ops: auto-unpin should be reversible and audited. We need a rollback route that preserves tokenizer version. Also need an alert to SRE and the customer's contacts.

rachel: Legal/CS note: customers will want assurances. We can offer "probation pin" that is explicitly time-limited (14 days) and requires a signed waiver that documents auto-unpin behavior.

mike: Implementation concerns: routing rules + canary buckets + automated metric checks. ETA for a minimal MVP ~10 business days if we reuse existing routing infra.

cam: Alternative is "shadow-pin": allow customer to request pining but keep traffic mirrored to both pinned model and fallback; only commit pin after probation metrics are clean. Lower risk but more infra cost.

yasmin: Shadow-pin seems safer for large customers. For small customers, probation pin might be faster. We should define tiers.

jorge: For shadow-pin we need a mirrored inference path + synchronized token counters. That adds ~15% CPU/GPU overhead during pilot. Ops can support for enterprise pilots only.

rachel: From compliance: audit trail must include artifact digest, timestamps of pin/unpin, and the metrics snapshots that triggered any action. Add retention of 90 days.

opsbot: infra-bot: noted: pin_probation_flow -> tracked, audit_retention=90d, shadow_pin_supported_for=enterprise_only

mike: Product decision points: (A) build probation-pin as self-serve for SMB with 14d TTL and waiver, (B) build shadow-pin for enterprise pilots only, (C) block all pin requests until both flows are live. My vote: A + B parallel, phased rollouts.

yasmin: Agree on A+B. Prioritize shadow-pin for compliance-heavy customers.

cam: Action items: jorge -> prototype shadow-mirroring (8d), mike -> routing + TTL enforcement (6d), rachel -> draft waiver + comms (3d), yasmin -> define metric thresholds and prompt set for probation (2d).

rachel: I'll loop in legal and CS and circulate a short template.

jorge: I'll start a small spike and post a follow-up with perf estimates.

cam: Good. We'll update the catalog policy docs to include both flows and an FAQ entry: "What happens if a pinned model is auto-unpinned?"

yasmin: Also add a note for devs: "pins are not guaranteed to preserve exact outputs across rollbacks".

mike: OK, starting work on routing. Reopening thread when spike results land.

cam: Thanks everyone. Closing for decision capture. We'll track tasks in the pin-probation epic. :white_check_mark:
